- Formed in Meriden, Connecticut in 1898, ISC brought together many independent historical silver manufacturers under one massive corporate umbrella.
-They became a dominant force in mid-century American tableware and produced these specific plain-walled, smooth-stemmed goblet styles in large numbers during the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s.

This collection features eight vintage estate tobacco pipes, including a notable Peterson's pipe and a commemorative 1993 Christmas pipe. The lot showcases a diverse array of traditional pipe shapes, finishes, and stem materials, representing classic mid-to-late 20th-century smoking accessories. These pieces are ideal for restoration enthusiasts or as additions to a historical smoking memorabilia collection.
Peterson's K&P estate pipe featuring a silver-tone metal band
Red-finished briar pipe marked "Christmas 1993" on the shank

Various briar wood pipes including straight and bent billiard shapes
One detached vintage dark wood pipe bowl

Plastic and vulcanite stems exhibit varying degrees of oxidation, surface scratches, and light teeth chatter. Finish wear, small nicks, and surface staining are visible on the wood surfaces. All items are sold as-is for restoration or display.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Bendos Action Figure Lot - 5 Figures and Accessories
Kid Galaxy, Vintage 1999-2000
3 Sealed In Tubes, 2 Loose
This collection features five bendable figures from Kid Galaxy's popular Bendos line, which dominated the poseable toy market in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Known for their distinct minimalist face designs and wire-core flexibility, Bendos are sought after for their unique aesthetic. This lot includes three factory-sealed figures in original cylindrical packaging and two loose figures with character-specific accessories.
Figures Included:
Mega-Parachute Bendo - Sealed in large tube #604, includes red parachute.
Santa Bendo - Sealed in tube #270, includes green toy sack accessory.
Diamond Softball Player - Sealed in tube #103, includes baseball bat.
Scuba Diver and Tech Figure - Loose figures with "Kid Galaxy" markings.
Accessories: Diving helmet, daisy acoustic guitar, two money bags, and snowboard.
Condition:
Three figures are factory sealed in original plastic tubes; tubes show light shelf wear and minor scuffing. Loose figures show minor paint rubs consistent with light use but retain full poseability. All included accessories are in good vintage condition with vibrant colors and no structural damage.

We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

description:
Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Together, these pieces provide a compelling study of mineral growth and make for excellent decorative display pieces or additions to a rock and mineral collection.
Total combined weight of 3.1 lbs as confirmed by digital scale measurement
One specimen features a distinct amethyst cluster with lavender-hued points and visible agate banding
Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging
Largest specimen measures approximately 5.5 inches in length based on visual scale
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.

Description
: Explore Earth's ancient past with this 12-piece Fossil Collection Kit, perfect for science enthusiasts and collectors alike. Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.

This intricate mixed media sculpture by artist John P. Koehler captures a stylized natural scene through a sophisticated combination of organic and artisanal materials. The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. The composition reflects the studio glass movement of the late 20th century, emphasizing the contrast between the translucent, fragile nature of glass and the raw, earthy textures of stone and wood.

We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.

Hemingray No. 12, CD 113
Aqua Blue-Green, Vintage Mid-Century
This lot features three vintage glass telegraph/telephone insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. The No. 12 model was a standard utility piece used extensively across North American communication lines. Today, these pieces are highly sought after by collectors for their historical significance, industrial aesthetic, and the iconic aqua color characteristic of Hemingray production.

Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Visible base chip
